mapper.select: select dept_id from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)

select d.dept_id from sys_dept d inner join sys_dept current_dept on current_dept.dept_id = #{deptId} where d.dept_id = current_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(#{deptId}, d.ancestors) or find_in_set(d.dept_id, current_dept.ancestors)

select d.dept_id from sys_dept current_dept inner join sys_dept d on ( d.dept_id = current_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(current_dept.dept_id, d.ancestors) or find_in_set(d.dept_id, current_dept.ancestors) ) where current_dept.dept_id = #{deptId} and current_dept.del_flag = '0' and current_dept.status = '0' and current_dept.dept_type = 'WAREHOUSE' and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' order by d.dept_id

select ancestor.dept_id from sys_dept current_dept inner join sys_dept ancestor on find_in_set(ancestor.dept_id, current_dept.ancestors) where current_dept.dept_id = #{deptId} and ancestor.dept_id <> 0 and ancestor.del_flag = '0' and ancestor.status = '0' order by find_in_set(ancestor.dept_id, current_dept.ancestors) desc

select cast( case when d.ancestors is null or d.ancestors = '' or d.ancestors = '0' then d.dept_id when d.ancestors like '0,%' then substring_index(substring_index(d.ancestors, ',', 2), ',', -1) else substring_index(d.ancestors, ',', 1) end as unsigned ) from sys_dept d where d.dept_id = #{deptId}

select d.dept_id from sys_user_shop us inner join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id inner join sys_dept d on ( d.dept_id = scope_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, d.ancestors) ) where us.user_id = #{userId} and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and scope_dept.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type = 'STORE' group by d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.order_num order by d.parent_id, d.order_num, d.dept_id
select d.dept_id from sys_dept d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type = 'STORE' order by d.parent_id, d.order_num, d.dept_id

select distinct target_dept.dept_id from sys_user_shop us inner join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id inner join sys_dept target_dept on ( target_dept.dept_id = scope_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, target_dept.ancestors) ) where us.user_id = #{userId} and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and scope_dept.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and target_dept.del_flag = '0' and target_dept.status = '0' and target_dept.dept_type in ('STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') order by target_dept.dept_id
select dept_id from sys_dept where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and dept_type in ('STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') order by dept_id
select count(1) from sys_dept where dept_id = #{targetDeptId} and (dept_id = #{scopeDeptId} or find_in_set(#{scopeDeptId}, ancestors))

select count(1) from sys_user_shop us inner join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id inner join sys_dept target_dept on target_dept.dept_id = #{deptId} where us.user_id = #{userId} and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and scope_dept.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and target_dept.del_flag = '0' and target_dept.status = '0' and target_dept.dept_type in ('STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and ( target_dept.dept_id = scope_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, target_dept.ancestors) )
select dept_type from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
